comments.author: idontcare
comments.body_html:
I use the linux server and get the following message on server start

Directory not found at [EFT root]/SPT/user/mods/SNACC/db/CustomItems

This is because the directory is called customitems (all lowercase) and filesystems on linux are case sensitive by default.
